name: qrencode
author: Kentaro Fukuchi and the libqrencode contributors
description: qrencode turns text, links and Wi-Fi credentials into a QR code drawn right in the Terminal, ready to scan with a phone, or saved as an SVG file. Type qrencode https://example.org.
usage: qrencode TEXT (QR in the Terminal) | qrencode -o FILE.svg TEXT | echo TEXT | qrencode [-l L|M|Q|H] [-t ascii]. Wi-Fi: qrencode 'WIFI:S:NAME;T:WPA;P:PASSWORD;;'

descriptions.en: qrencode turns text, links and Wi-Fi credentials into a QR code drawn right in the Terminal, ready to scan with a phone, or saved as an SVG file. Type qrencode https://example.org.
descriptions.it: qrencode trasforma testo, link e credenziali Wi-Fi in un codice QR disegnato direttamente nel Terminale, pronto da inquadrare con il telefono, o salvato come file SVG. Scrivi qrencode https://example.org.

does.en: Makes QR codes: in the Terminal for a phone to scan, or as an SVG file. Wi-Fi: 'WIFI:S:NAME;T:WPA;P:PASS;;'. Run: qrencode TEXT | qrencode -o FILE.svg TEXT
does.it: Crea codici QR: nel Terminale da inquadrare col telefono, o come file SVG. Wi-Fi: 'WIFI:S:NOME;T:WPA;P:PASS;;'. Uso: qrencode TESTO | qrencode -o FILE.svg TESTO
